resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives Pike County and coordinates near Velpen; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Dubois County. Story reports both; the coordinates support Pike.

NHLR says the Indiana DOF erected it and the Forest Service later owned it. Mark A says it was state property in 1946 and 1960 and may have been both state and federal at different times. Story gives the NHLR sequence and flags the uncertainty.

notes_for_editor: Re-erection year is not in any source read, so no rebuild event is listed. No source names staff or fires for the tower. The record's source page '../us-in-spears-john-spears/' was not in the cache and was not read. Mark A's original-site coordinates (38.38, -86.55) differ from the record's Velpen coordinates, as expected for a relocated tower. Ownership sequence and county are the two conflicts; both are flagged. Visit access is by invitation only, so the story does not encourage a visit. No photos added.
